picks.title: Chamath Palihapitiya raises $135M Series A for his AI coding startup, takes CEO role
picks.why_it_matters: A $135M Series A signals continued strong investor appetite for AI coding tools, validating the category and setting valuation benchmarks for competing startups in the space.

picks.title: Omen AI's plan to optimize data centers is all wet
picks.why_it_matters: Data center infrastructure optimization is becoming a critical investment thesis as AI compute demand strains cooling and efficiency systems—this $31M Series A highlights an emerging category worth monitoring.

picks.title: South Korea to spend $1T on more memory chip production and humanoid robots
picks.why_it_matters: Massive government capital flowing into memory chips and humanoid robotics creates downstream opportunities for startups building software, components, or applications in these ecosystems.
